title: mon_coord.settings_of cuts a kb root's settings source to settings.json, since kbsettings.explain now gives it relative to the root
goal: mon_coord.settings_of reports the source of a kb root's setting as kb/NAME/settings.json: its source() helper takes the relative path kbsettings.explain now gives (BG-vbkdm7vw) as it took the absolute one, and no longer cuts it to the file name

run: import sys, tempfile, os, json; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import mon_coord; T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, 'kb', 'team')); json.dump({'coordination': {'strategy': {'working': 'after'}}}, open(os.path.join(T, 'kb', 'team', 'settings.json'), 'w')); s, _ = mon_coord.settings_of(T); sys.exit(0 if s['strategy.working']['source'] == 'kb/team/settings.json' else 1)
